description:
The University of Helsinki is known as a university founded in the city of Turku in 1640. The university has been in Helsinki since 1829 and is considered Finland's oldest and largest university with the widest range of disciplines. The university is home to 11 faculties and 11 research institutes. It offers students undergraduate, graduate, and doctoral degrees in a variety of disciplines. However, it hosts approximately 32 thousand students. The number of international students is known to be about 2,000 and this is one of the reasons why the University of Helsinki is among the best options for international students who want to study in Finland. Lastly, the university is also among the top 100 universities in the world.

In terms of the language of the instruction, in addition to Finnish and Swedish programs at the university; English education options are also offered. It is known that the University of Helsinki is a member of various university networks such as Europaeum, UNICA, Utrecht.  Besides, the university stands out in fields such as computer science, genetics, molecular biosciences. The university is also among the best options for those who want to study mathematics in Finland. Many scientists and Nobel laureates are among the notable alumni of the University of Helsinki.  University of Helsinki welcomes students from many countries of the world every year. Many opportunities are offered to students such as academicians who are experts in their fields, research budgets, and university-industry collaborations. Students have the opportunity to receive free education or have the opportunity to be one of the students supported by scholarship. After graduation, they can benefit from internship and career opportunities.

Generally, you will need to have completed secondary education (high school) or an equivalent qualification. Then, you are supposed to submit your application. In this regard, you can usually submit your application online through the university's website or through the Lithuanian Higher Education Institutions Application System.
